instruction: Explain online PF withdrawal process and Form 31 for advance.
input: How to withdraw PF advance online from EPFO for medical emergencies?
output:
To withdraw PF advance online from EPFO:
1) Login to Unified Member Portal (epfindia.gov.in) with UAN and password.
2) Go to Online Services -> Claim (Form-31, 19, 10C).
3) Select Form 31 (PF Advance) and select 'Illness/Medical emergency' as the reason (no minimum service requirement).
4) Upload scanned cancelled cheque / passbook copy and verify via Aadhaar OTP.

instruction: Explain the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana solar subsidy scheme.
input: Hello, PM Surya Ghar Yojana me solar lagwane par kitni subsidy milti hai?
output:
PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana ke tahat:
1) 1 kW system par ₹30,000 subsidy milti hai.
2) 2 kW system par ₹60,000 subsidy milti hai.
3) 3 kW ya usse upar ke system par ₹78,000 tak ki central subsidy milti hai.
4) Apply karne ke liye pmsuryaghar.gov.in portal par DISCOM consumer number ke sath register karein.

instruction: Makan malik bina notice ke rent badha sakta hai kya?
input: makan malik ne achanak rent badha diya bina kisi notice ke, kya karein?
output:
Kirayedari niyam ke anusaar:
1) Makan malik agreement period ke dauran achanak rent nahi badha sakta.
2) Model Tenancy Act ke mutabik rent badhane ke liye kam se kam 3 mahine pehle likhit notice dena zaroori hai.
3) Agar agreement me koi clause mention hai toh usi ke hisaab se hike lagu hoga.

instruction: Explain how LPG subsidy works under the PAHEL scheme and what to do if subsidy is not credited.
input: Hello, LPG gas cylinder ka subsidy nahi mila, complaint kaise karein?
output:
PAHEL scheme ke tahat subsidy na milne par:
1) Cash memo par 17-digit LPG ID check karein.
2) mylpg.in portal par subsidy transfer status dekhein.
3) Ensure karein ki saal ka 12 cylinder quota khatam na hua ho.
4) Toll-Free number 1800-2333-555 par complaint register karein ya distributor se sampark karein.

instruction: Explain PM-KISAN scheme eligibility and benefits in Hindi.
input: pm किसान योजना में कितने पैसे मिलते हैं और किसे मिलते हैं?
output:
पीएम-किसान योजना के तहत:
1) पात्र किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की आर्थिक सहायता मिलती है।
2) यह राशि ₹2,000 की तीन समान किस्तों में सीधे आधार-सीडेड बैंक खाते में भेजी जाती है।
3) पात्रता: जिन किसानों के नाम राजस्व रिकॉर्ड में कृषि भूमि है। (सरकारी कर्मचारी, टैक्सपेयर्स और पेशेवर इसके पात्र नहीं हैं)।

instruction: How to check PM Kisan beneficiary status online?
input: how can i check if my name is in pm kisan list online?
output:
To check your PM-KISAN status:
1) Visit the official website: pmkisan.gov.in
2) Click on 'Know Your Status' in the Farmers Corner.
3) Enter your Registration Number or Registered Mobile Number and Captcha.
4) Check the status of 'e-KYC Done', 'Eligibility', and 'Land Seeding' (all three must say YES).

instruction: Explain how to challenge an abnormally high electricity bill and request a meter accuracy test.
input: Hello, My electricity bill came 3 times higher than usual. How to complain?
output:
To resolve an abnormally high electricity bill:
1) Verify your physical meter reading against the current reading printed on your bill.
2) Check if your bill was calculated on 'Actual' or 'Average / Provisional' basis.
3) Submit a written complaint to your local SDO / DISCOM office requesting a check meter installation under the Electricity Supply Code.
4) If unresolved within 30 days, escalate to the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum (CGRF) and Ombudsman.
